About the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian network, with 191 member National Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. IFRC uses the Triple R – response, resilience and respect – to deliver on Strategy 2030. IFRC responds to disasters and crises, ensuring timely, coordinated and locally led humanitarian action. IFRC supports its members in building community resilience in the areas of climate and environment, health and wellbeing, and migration and displacement. IFRC promotes respect for our fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality, including in our work on values, power and inclusion. The IFRC focuses throughout on our core mandate – our raison d’être – of strategic and operational coordination, humanitarian diplomacy, National Society development, and accountability. IFRC is led by its Secretary General and has its Headquarters in Geneva and five regional offices in Africa (Nairobi); the Americas (Panama); Asia Pacific (Kuala Lumpur); Europe (Budapest); and MENA (Beirut) as well as representation offices, service centres and delegations across the globe. IFRC has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment and other forms of harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, and lack of integrity (including but not limited to financial misconduct). IFRC also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles. For more information, visit www.ifrc.org/. Role Purpose The Regional Director leads IFRC’s work in the region and is a member of the Global Leadership Team (GLT). Under the overall leadership of the Secretary General and the direct line management of the USG-NSDC, the Regional Director provides vision, leadership, strategic guidance, and effective management of the IFRC Secretariat’s work and resources in the region of assignment, including in the relevant strategic areas of National Society development, operations coordination, partnerships and humanitarian diplomacy, and management. The Regional Director also coordinates activities closely with the Executive Office; Under-Secretary General, Humanitarian Diplomacy and Digitalization (HDD); and the Under-Secretary General, People and Strategy (PAS), to ensure effective coordination across the IFRC Secretariat. Major Duties and Responsibilities Champion and ensure effective and agile model of leadership working as one IFRC. Within the framework of IFRC’s Strategy 2030, the Agenda for Renewal, and the IFRC Way of Working, and under the guidance of the USG-NSDC, the Regional Director is responsible for providing strategic leadership across the region and ensuring impactful support to National Societies. This includes strengthening their capacities to reduce and address fragility, enhance resilience, and ensure effective readiness and preparedness for crises. As a member of the Global Leadership Team, the Regional Director is responsible for ensuring that IFRC operates as one organization, maximizing and connecting capacities, expertise, and resources at delegations, and global levels. The Regional Director will provide leadership for the implementation of the Agenda for Renewal and the IFRC Way of Working, translating these directions into effective regional and country-level action in support of the ambitions and objectives of Strategy 2030. Ensure delivery of the five strategic priorities underpinned by the five strategic shifts of IFRC Renewal and support National Societies in advancing the implementation of Strategy 2030 Ensure that the IFRC secretariat efforts are focused on mobilizing investments in delivering relevant and effective programs and services by national societies in the areas of: Response – in scale, speed and scope that is comprehensive and people- focused Resilience – focusing on climate and environmental challenges, health and wellbeing and migration and identity, and Respect - for our fundamental principles and our work on values, power and inclusion. Lead the implementation of the five Strategic shifts of the IFRC Renewal in the region, ensuring that deepening localisation and accountability; sharpening humanitarian focus, influence, and impact; intensifying trust and collaboration; accelerating digital transformation and AI adoption; and fostering a more innovative and agile Secretariat are fully integrated into Regional and Delegation plans and translated into measurable results. Place People and National Societies at the centre of IFRC planning, decision-making, and operational delivery, ensuring that support reflects their priorities and capacities while strengthening accountability to communities, agility, principled conduct, partnerships, and alignment with IFRC statutory instruments and General Assembly resolutions. Ensure that the Global teams and Delegations operate as one IFRC system, effectively connecting delegations and global capacities, tools, standards, and resources to strengthen preparedness, readiness, and response capabilities of National Societies and IFRC offices and maximize collective impact. Provide strategic oversight of country-level capacity, resources, and delegated authority, ensuring implementation of the target of at least 75% of financial resources at country level, appropriate delegation of authority, robust first- and second-line oversight, transparency and accountability, and adherence to technical quality standards while maximizing the effective use of resources. Ensure National Society Development Provide strategic leadership and direction for National Society development and strengthening across the region, ensuring that IFRC regional and country teams prioritize investment in stronger, more sustainable, accountable, and trusted National Societies as critical local humanitarian actors and partners of choice. Lead strategic engagement with National Society leadership, maintaining regular dialogue to understand priorities and concerns, identify opportunities for collaboration, and advance institutional development, including integrity, safeguarding, systems strengthening, financial sustainability and domestic income generation, branch development, and stronger relationships with public authorities. Direct and oversee efforts to strengthen the institutional foundations and effectiveness of National Societies, including their legal base and auxiliary role, Unified Plans and operational plans, and the development and implementation of policies, systems, programmes, and capacity-strengthening initiatives that enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, accountability, engagement, and trust of IFRC membership. Drive coordinated and evidence-based investment in National Society development, ensuring consistent use of the National Society Investment Dashboard across regional and delegation teams to identify priorities, align technical and financial resources, coordinate partner support, and establish appropriate investment mechanisms at country and regional levels. Strengthen leadership, volunteering, youth, and branch development across the region, including regional leadership-development initiatives, mentoring future leaders, advancing women in leadership, promoting strategic foresight and leadership learning, and ensuring that all teams actively contribute technical and financial resources to agreed strategies and plans. Provide strategic leadership, management, and coordination for high-quality support to National Societies, ensuring that relevant internal and external analysis informs strategic alignment across the region and that IFRC support enables National Societies to strengthen community resilience and address the needs of vulnerable people across health, social, economic, and other programme areas, consistent with priorities established by the Secretary General and under the overall guidance of the USG-NSDC. Lead Strategic and Operational Coordination Responsible for ensuring coordination is integral component for the IFRC Renewal in action across the region: Membership Cooperation, including IFRC Secretariat and its member NSs implement the IFRC Way of Working and use IFRC policies as key reference guidance to work effectively as a network. Movement Coordination, including IFRC, its member NSs and the ICRC implement the Seville Agreement 2.0 and its tools. Coordination with external partners, such as governments, international organizations, civil society organizations, NGOs, private sector entities, and other stakeholders involved in humanitarian work. Ensure that Federation policies, procedures, guidelines, and quality standards are properly implemented, and adhered by staff and all partners with whom the Federation works. Ensure adequate cooperation and coordination in all programmes and operations ensuring the most effective and efficient mobilisation and utilisation of resources. Build effective cooperation and partnerships with a wide range of partners and stakeholders in government, civil society, academia, and the private sector, and where appropriate engage with the UN Country Team and other humanitarian actors. Ensure that the Cooperation Policy and other Policies are effectively implemented and monitored. Provide strategic leadership for IFRC engagement and dialogue with the ICRC across the region, fostering strong coordination, joint context analysis, and timely identification of Movement-wide opportunities, challenges, and risks, and promoting coherent and complementary action in support of National Societies and the wider Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. Lead Effective Humanitarian Diplomacy Provide strategic leadership for purpose-driven humanitarian diplomacy, communications, and external relations across the region, translating IFRC global strategies and positions into regional priorities and establishing consistent protocols and approaches for external engagement across the Regional Office and Country Delegations. Build and strengthen strategic partnerships and broad alliances that advance shared humanitarian priorities and position IFRC and its network of National Societies as partners of choice, including proactive engagement with regional intergovernmental organizations, international financial institutions, embassies, academia, civil society, and other influential regional and international actors. Represent and advocate for IFRC positions on key humanitarian and development issues in high-level regional, Movement, and external forums, contributing regional perspectives to Federation-wide policy development and ensuring that the priorities and ambitions of National Societies are effectively promoted and supported. Champion the Fundamental Principles and a principled approach to humanitarian action across the region, ensuring that IFRC teams lead by example, consistently apply Federation-wide standards and guidance, and work with National Societies to address stigma, discrimination, social exclusion, and violence while contributing to peace and social harmony. Ensure effective regional advocacy and strategic alignment around National Society priorities, enabling Country Delegations and the Regional Office to support, promote, disseminate, and advocate for National Society humanitarian and development priorities, plans, and actions with relevant partners and decision-makers. Drive stronger information management and digital transformation in support of humanitarian action and influence, ensuring timely and relevant analysis and reporting for IFRC senior leadership, humanitarian diplomacy, communications, and decision-making, while supporting Federation-wide digital transformation to strengthen IFRC's capacity to serve National Societies and remain fit for the future. Ensure Agility Drive an agile, adaptive, and accountable approach to IFRC operations across the region, strengthening systems, processes, and ways of working to improve responsiveness, effectiveness, quality, and impact in support of National Societies. Ensure appropriate capacity and resources are positioned at country level, enabling IFRC teams to provide effective support to National Societies on core priorities and ensuring that financial resources are allocated strategically to maximize country-level impact. Exercise sound judgment, creativity, and flexibility in implementing IFRC decisions and strengthening coordination, ensuring effective engagement with National Societies, the wider Movement, donors, humanitarian actors, the private sector, and other relevant stakeholders. review_candidates.title: Projectmanager Datacenter Power Solutions
review_candidates.description: Wat vertel je thuis? Dankzij jou worden datacenters in Europa op een efficiënte en effectieve wijze voorzien van betrouwbare power oplossingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat zij hun cruciale rol kunnen blijven vervullen met robuuste backup power oplossingen én, in een veranderende markt, steeds vaker ook met prime power toepassingen. Ben jij de projectmanager die overzicht houdt, mensen verbindt en complexe technische projecten veilig, voorspelbaar en succesvol realiseert? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Waar jij energie van krijgt Als Projectmanager Datacenter Power Solutions ben je integraal verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van opdrachten van datacenterklanten voor power solutions. Je bewaakt product, tijd, geld, kwaliteit en veiligheid en stuurt projecten aan vanaf overdracht door sales tot en met engineering, inkoop, levering, installatie, commissioning en oplevering. Het gaat om technisch complexe projecten voor hyperscale datacenters, vaak in een internationale omgeving met opdrachtgevers, bouwbedrijven, engineeringsbureaus, leveranciers en lokale onderaannemers. Daarbij beweeg je mee met een markt waarin de vraag zich verbreedt van noodstroomvoorzieningen naar complete backup power én prime power oplossingen. Een greep uit jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Aansturen van één of meerdere datacenterprojecten en de bijbehorende projectorganisatie, inclusief planning, engineering, uitvoering, financieel beheer, kwaliteit en veiligheid; Afstemmen van operationele plannen en uitvoering met opdrachtgevers, leveranciers, hoofd- en onderaannemers in een complex internationaal speelveld; Bewaken van contract, scope, engineering, technische specificaties, tekeningen, documentatie en klantgoedkeuringen; Coördineren van inkoop, productie, logistiek, levering, installatie en commissioning van Caterpillar-generatoren, besturingssystemen en randapparatuur; Signaleren en oplossen van organisatorische, technische en contractuele knelpunten tijdens voorbereiding, bouw en installatie; Rapporteren aan interne stakeholders en opdrachtgevers over veiligheid, kwaliteit, voortgang, financiën, risico’s en organisatie. Jouw motor In deze rol ben jij de regisseur van het project. Je doorgrondt het contract, stelt samen met het team een projectplan en planning op en zorgt dat de juiste leveranciers, onderaannemers en interne specialisten op het juiste moment worden betrokken. Je houdt overzicht over de kritieke punten, weet hoofd- en bijzaken te scheiden en stuurt dagelijks bij waar dat nodig is. Je communiceert helder en professioneel, ook in het Engels, en voelt je thuis in een internationale omgeving waarin veel afstemming op afstand plaatsvindt. Met jouw structuur, zelfstandigheid en analytische blik zorg je dat projecten voorspelbaar verlopen en dat datacenterklanten kunnen rekenen op betrouwbare energievoorziening voor hun kritische infrastructuur. Jij bent de perfecte match voor Zeppelin Power als je daarnaast beschikt over de volgende vaardigheden en ervaring: Een afgeronde technische hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur richting werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek, energietechniek of vergelijkbaar; 5 tot 10 jaar relevante ervaring met contract- en/of projectmanagement van installatie-, energie- of bouwkundige projecten; Sterke managementcompetenties op het gebied van aansturen, motiveren, plannen, monitoren, analyseren en bijsturen; Een flexibele, analytische, professionele, servicegerichte en ontwikkelingsgerichte houding, met een hoge mate van zelfstandigheid en initiatief; Bereidheid om te reizen binnen voornamelijk Noordwest-Europa en uitstekend ontwikkelde communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Jouw Powerpakket Werken bij Zeppelin Power betekent werken in een dynamische en technisch uitdagende omgeving, waarin je bijdraagt aan betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige energieoplossingen. We bieden een samenwerkende en ondersteunende werkomgeving die je stimuleert om initiatief te nemen in je professionele én persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Onze medewerkers beschrijven de cultuur als open, direct, informeel en professioneel – jouw ideeën en bijdrage worden écht gewaardeerd. Hier mag je op rekenen: Een bruto fulltime maandsalaris vanaf € 5.500 per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring, en een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus; 40 verlofdagen om goed tot rust te komen (27 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV dagen); Een mooie pensioenregeling; jouw bijdrage is 10% en 20% dragen wij bij; Mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een collectieve zorgverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilverenkruis met werkgeversbijdrage van €20,- per maand; De mogelijkheid om je continu te ontwikkelen via opleidingen, zoals (technische) producttrainingen via onze eigen Training Academy en een ruim aanbod van e-learnings voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling; Een laptop en smartphone van de zaak, zodat je goed je werk kunt doen; Een elektrische leaseauto; Mogelijkheid tot het meedoen aan Power Fit activiteiten (bijvoorbeeld boksen, padellen, kanoën en meer). Over Zeppelin Power Sinds 1926 zijn wij dé officiële Caterpillar dealer in Nederland. Vandaag zetten we die rijke geschiedenis voort onder een nieuwe naam: Zeppelin Power Systems Netherlands B.V. Als onderdeel van de internationale Zeppelin Group, bieden wij krachtige, slimme en toekomstbestendige oplossingen op het gebied van aandrijving, energie en duurzaamheid – met de vertrouwde kwaliteit en service die klanten van ons gewend zijn. Of het nu gaat om de voortstuwing van schepen, het aandrijven van industriële machines, noodstroomvoorzieningen, complete warmtekrachtinstallaties of het oplossen van netcongestie: wij leveren maatwerk dat werkt. Met zes servicevestigingen in Nederland, 24/7 ondersteuning en een wereldwijd netwerk van specialisten staan we altijd voor onze klanten klaar. Wil je bij ons aan de slag? Ben jij klaar om jouw energie en skills in te zetten bij Zeppelin Power? We ontmoeten je graag! Stuur je CV en motivatie via de sollicitatieknop. Wij nemen binnen één werkweek contact met je op.

Personal Data Privacy This Personal Information Collection Statement applies to the collection, use and handling of personal data by the employing company within Chinachem Group (the “Company”) pursuant to the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486). “Chinachem Group” refers to Chinachem Group Holdings Limited and its holding companies, subsidiaries, affiliates and associated companies. The types of personal data the Company collects from you may include (1) your personal particulars (e.g. your name); (2) your contact information (e.g. telephone number or email address); and (3) your employment information (collectively “Personal Data”). The Personal Data you provide will be treated with utmost confidentiality and used for recruitment related purposes including the assessment of your suitability to assume the job duties of the position you have applied and to determine remuneration offer. While the provision of full and complete information is necessary for our selection process, sharing your personal details is a voluntary decision. Failure to provide any of the requested data may impact the processing and outcome of your application. All Personal Data provided by you will be retained for a maximum of 24 months and then subsequently erased. Where there are suitable vacancies in the Company’s subsidiaries or associate companies during that period, we may transfer your application to them for consideration of employment, but only with your prior consent. Save and except your current or former employers, academic institutions and service providers engaged by the Company for reference checking purpose, your Personal Data will not be disclosed to any third parties for other unrelated purposes without your prior consent.
